# Supabase

Generated from [tokens.json](tokens.json) and [README.md](README.md) by the design-systems catalog tool. Do not edit this file: change the tokens through the package's builders, then run `make design-md` at the repository root.

It follows the DESIGN.md spec, version alpha. That format has no themes, no per-value provenance and only px, em and rem units, so this file holds the `light` theme alone with every alias resolved. [tokens.json](tokens.json) is the source of truth: it records where each value was read, holds the `dark` theme, and keeps the 14 tokens from these groups that DESIGN.md cannot hold (gradients, shadows, percentages, durations and other non-colour or non-px values).

## Overview

Good for: Developer dashboards, code editors, member tables, settings, log filters, invitations and responsive navigation; database editing gaps documented.

Captured 2026-10-31, signed in, free account; both projects paused; public landing. Themes: dark, light.

Supabase public landing page and signed-in free-account dashboard, captured on 2026-10-31 using Codex visible in-app browser. Both existing projects were paused. The owner approved capturing accessible pages and documenting editor gaps. No project was resumed, SQL executed, data edited, paid feature activated or invitation sent.

App evidence: System theme displayed dark; Light was temporarily selected with approval and System restored and verified. Desktop viewport measured 1280 × 720, DPR 2, with 1280 × 720 screenshot pixels. Mobile override measured 390 × 844, DPR 1, with matching pixels; override restored. Public landing captures are dark only. Light app coverage includes project settings, team desktop/mobile, invitations desktop/mobile, theme controls and shortcut switches, plus the earlier project list and status filter. Other added pages remain dark-only.

No fonts are distributed; their licences were not reviewed.

## Do's and Don'ts

- Do take values from [tokens.json](tokens.json) when you need another theme, a value's source, or a token this file leaves out.
- Do read [README.md](README.md) before relying on a value; it says what is known to be wrong.
- Don't read colours off the screenshots; they are 256-colour PNGs.
- Don't copy the product's logo, icons, illustrations or brand colours into something that ships. Borrow structure and proportions.
- Don't edit this file; it is regenerated from the tokens.

### What to distrust (from README.md)

This now covers accessible dashboard pages beyond the shell, but interaction and theme coverage is still partial. Database tables, schema navigation, row details and table filters were unavailable because both projects were paused. The empty SQL side panel and snippet picker are real app evidence, but do not prove a functioning SQL connection or results UI. Public dashboard illustrations are not interactive app evidence; none of the rejected demo screenshots enters this package.

The initial full-page attempts missed lazy-loaded content or misplaced the sticky header and were rejected. Viewport screenshots are retained instead. Browser screenshots arrived as JPEG bytes and were decoded, converted to PNG, then quantized; token colours come from CSS, never pixels. Screenshots are at native browser-output scale, not inferred from DPR. Mobile screenshots show a notice overlay as the product presented it. Captured means at least one documented example, not complete state parity.

### Do and don't (from README.md)

- **Keep project context in the top breadcrumb.** Organization, project and branch stay visible above the narrow icon rail ([paused project](screenshots/app-paused-project.png)); do not replace that hierarchy with an undifferentiated menu.
- **Use compact bordered controls for secondary actions.** Reserve the filled accent for primary actions ([projects](screenshots/app-projects-grid.png)); do not fill every toolbar action with accent.
- **Place filters beside search.** Show the checkbox popup anchored below Status ([filter](screenshots/app-status-filter.png)); do not detach it from the list toolbar.
- **Give command search a centered dialog.** Dim the app behind the dialog and keep query input above results ([command menu](screenshots/app-command-menu.png)); do not mix global commands into individual project cards.
- **Adapt navigation at mobile width.** Use the floating toolbar and organization menu ([mobile navigation](screenshots/app-mobile-navigation.png)); do not compress the desktop icon rail into the content column.
